Applicazione del Binding del Token

A security control requiring the cryptographic binding of authentication tokens to specific TLS sessions or client devices to prevent token theft and replay attacks.

Questions and answers

What is Applicazione del Binding del Token?

In this glossary, Applicazione del Binding del Token refers to: A security control requiring the cryptographic binding of authentication tokens to specific TLS sessions or client devices to prevent token theft and replay attacks.

How is Applicazione del Binding del Token used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "L'applicazione del binding del token è abilitata su tutte le API pubbliche, garantendo che i token non possano essere riutilizzati da sessioni non autorizzate."

Definition

A security control requiring the cryptographic binding of authentication tokens to specific TLS sessions or client devices to prevent token theft and replay attacks.

Operational example

Token binding enforcement is enabled on all public-facing APIs, ensuring that tokens cannot be replayed from unauthorized sessions.

Localized term
